two-sample-z-interval.def: A confidence interval for the difference of two population proportions, $p_1 - p_2$: $(\hat{p}_1 - \hat{p}_2) \pm z^* \sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}_1(1-\hat{p}_1)}{n_1} + \frac{\hat{p}_2(1-\hat{p}_2)}{n_2}}$. It needs two independent random samples (or two randomly assigned groups) and at least 10 successes and 10 failures in each.
